title_en: Chinese History (9/20): The Invention of Movable Type
note_en: 与 A 相比 means "compared with A" and usually opens the sentence, setting up the point of comparison before the result: 与雕版相比，活字印刷……大大提高了印刷的速度 "Compared with woodblocks, movable type... made printing much faster." It is more formal than 比, and unlike 比 it doesn't need an adjective right after it; the result can be any clause. The text also uses the related 相比之下 "by contrast."
